Reference - Authors: L Jespers; S Jenné; I Lasters; D Collen
Reference - Title: Epitope mapping by negative selection of randomized antigen libraries displayed on filamentous phage.
Epitope - Comments: The residue numbers Lys35 and Lys130 corresponds to the positions in the mature protein.
1st immunogen - Dose Schedule: Mice were immunized with 10 µg of SakSTAR in CFA and boosted i.p. 2 week later with 10 µg of SakSTAR in IFA. Six weeks later mice were boosted i.p. with 10 µg of SakSTAR in saline 4 and 2 days before fusion with myeloma cells.
Assay - Comments: Lys130 was determined to be a critical residue in the epitope for MAb MA-7H11. After 2 cycles of negative selection of a randomized library of Sak-phage variants defective in binding to immobilized MAb MA-7H11 and positive selection on immobilized plasmin, four distinct single Sak mutants with Lys130 preferentially mutated to Gln or Asn were selected that retained binding to the nonoverlapping MAb MA-3G10 and plasminogen-activation activity. Analyses by surface plasmon resonance showed that soluble Sak mutants with single changes of Lys130 to Gln, Asn, Glu, Tyr, or Ala reduced binding to MAbs MA-7H11 and MA-25E1 >49-1000-fold without significantly affecting binding to other nonoverlapping anti-Sak MAbs The Sak mutants bound to and activated plasminogen.

Epitope - Comments: The epitope residues were calculated from [PDB: 8YBM] as the antigen residues at 4Å atomic distance from the antibody.
Immunization - Comments: Generation of the nanobody was previously described in the cited reference: [PMID: 37368700]. SEB-reactive nanobodies were screened by phage display technology using a library developed from an immunized camel. One camelid (Camelus bactrianus) was immunized five times with a three-week interval between injections of an emulsion of the SEB toxoid. Total RNA was isolated from peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) and used to generate a VHH phage display library. SEB-binding nanobodies were enriched by four rounds of bio-panning against the SEB toxoid.
Assay - Comments: The affinity of epitope-specific nanobody Nb6 for binding to staphylococcal enterotoxin B (SEB) was determined by SPR.
